01407:     private fun finishDownload(targetFilePath: String? = null) {
01408:         try {
01409:             val key = targetFilePath ?: activeDownloads.keys.firstOrNull() ?: return
01410:             val session = activeDownloads.remove(key) ?: return
01411:
01412:             session.outputStream?.flush()
01413:             session.outputStream?.close()
01414:
01415:             val fileName = session.fileName
01416:             val totalSize = session.receivedBytes
01417:             val ctx = session.context
01418:
01419:             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
01420:                 if (it.filePath == key) {
01421:                     it.copy(bytesTransferred = totalSize, totalBytes = totalSize, isCompleted = true)
01422:                 } else {
01423:                     it
01424:                 }
01425:             }
01426:
01427:             scope.launch {
01428:                 delay(1200)
01429:                 _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != key }
01430:             }
01431:
01432:             if (ctx != null) {
01433:                 showDownloadCompleteNotification(ctx, fileName, key, totalSize)
01434:                 scope.launch(Dispatchers.Main) {
01435:                     Toast.makeText(
01436:                         ctx,
01437:                         "Descarga completada: $fileName (${formatSize(totalSize)}) en carpeta Downloads",
01438:                         Toast.LENGTH_LONG
01439:                     ).show()
01440:                 }
01441:             }
01442:         } catch (e: Exception) {
01443:             Log.e("MeshFilesDownload", "Error finishing download: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
01444:         }
01445:     }

01447:     private fun startFileCopyStream(srcPath: String, destPath: String, size: Long, context: Context? = null) {
01448:         val targetName = destPath.substringAfterLast('/')
01449:         if (size == 0L) {
01450:             uploadRawFileToPath(destPath, ByteArray(0), context)
01451:             _statusMessage.value = "Copiado exitosamente: $targetName"
01452:             _clipboardItem.value = null
01453:             return
01454:         }
01455:
01456:         val progress = TransferProgress(
01457:             fileName = targetName,
01458:             filePath = destPath,
01459:             isUpload = false,
01460:             bytesTransferred = 0L,
01461:             totalBytes = size,
01462:             type = TransferType.COPY
01463:         )
01464:         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != destPath } + progress
01465:
01466:         copyingSourcePath = srcPath
01467:         copyingDestPath = destPath
01468:         copyingTotalSize = size
01469:         copyingReceivedBytes = 0L
01470:
01471:         try {
01472:             copyingTempFile = File.createTempFile("mesh_copy_", ".tmp", context?.cacheDir)
01473:             copyingFileOutputStream = FileOutputStream(copyingTempFile)
01474:         } catch (e: Exception) {
01475:             Log.e("MeshFilesCopy", "Error creating copy temp file: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
01476:         }
01477:
01478:         val session = ActiveCopyMoveSession(
01479:             filePath = destPath,
01480:             fileName = targetName,
01481:             isMove = false,
01482:             transferredBytes = 0L,
01483:             totalSize = size,
01484:             job = null,
01485:             context = context
01486:         )
01487:         activeCopyMoveSessions[destPath] = session
01488:
01489:         val reqId = Random.nextInt(100000, 999999)
01490:
01491:         val parentDir = if (srcPath.contains('/')) {
01492:             srcPath.substringBeforeLast('/').ifEmpty { "/" }
01493:         } else {
01494:             _currentPath.value
01495:         }
01496:         val fileName = srcPath.substringAfterLast('/')
01497:
01498:         val req1 = JsonObject().apply {
01499:             addProperty("action", "download")
01500:             addProperty("path", parentDir)
01501:             addProperty("file", fileName)
01502:             addProperty("subaction", "start")
01503:             addProperty("id", reqId)
01504:         }
01505:         webSocket?.send(req1.toString())
01506:
01507:         scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
01508:             delay(50)
01509:             val req2 = JsonObject().apply {
01510:                 addProperty("action", "download")
01511:                 addProperty("path", parentDir)
01512:                 addProperty("file", fileName)
01513:                 addProperty("subaction", "download")
01514:                 addProperty("id", reqId)
01515:             }
01516:             webSocket?.send(req2.toString())
01517:         }
01518:     }

01520:     private fun finishCopyingFile() {
01521:         try {
01522:             val destPath = copyingDestPath ?: return
01523:             val targetName = destPath.substringAfterLast('/')
01524:             val tempFile = copyingTempFile
01525:
01526:             try {
01527:                 copyingFileOutputStream?.flush()
01528:                 copyingFileOutputStream?.close()
01529:             } catch (_: Exception) {}
01530:             copyingFileOutputStream = null
01531:
01532:             copyingSourcePath = null
01533:             copyingDestPath = null
01534:             copyingTotalSize = 0L
01535:             copyingReceivedBytes = 0L
01536:             copyingTempFile = null
01537:
01538:             if (tempFile != null && tempFile.exists() && activeCopyMoveSessions.containsKey(destPath)) {
01539:                 scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
01540:                     try {
01541:                         val fileLen = tempFile.length()
01542:                         val totalSize = fileLen.coerceAtLeast(1L)
01543:                         val uploadReq = JsonObject().apply {
01544:                             addProperty("action", "upload")
01545:                             addProperty("path", destPath)
01546:                             addProperty("size", fileLen)
01547:                         }
01548:                         webSocket?.send(uploadReq.toString())
01549:                         delay(100)
01550:
01551:                         FileInputStream(tempFile).use { input ->
01552:                             val buffer = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
01553:                             var uploaded = 0L
01554:                             while (activeCopyMoveSessions.containsKey(destPath)) {
01555:                                 val read = input.read(buffer)
01556:                                 if (read == -1) break
01557:                                 val chunk = ByteString.of(*buffer.copyOfRange(0, read))
01558:                                 webSocket?.send(chunk)
01559:                                 uploaded += read
01560:
01561:                                 val prog = (totalSize / 2) + if (fileLen > 0) (uploaded * totalSize) / (fileLen * 2) else 0L
01562:                                 _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
01563:                                     if (it.filePath == destPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = prog.coerceAtMost(totalSize), totalBytes = totalSize) else it
01564:                                 }
01565:                                 delay(10)
01566:                             }
01567:                         }
01568:
01569:                         if (activeCopyMoveSessions.containsKey(destPath)) {
01570:                             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
01571:                                 if (it.filePath == destPath) it.copy(bytesTransferred = totalSize, isCompleted = true) else it
01572:                             }
01573:                             _clipboardItem.value = null
01574:                             clipboardNodeId = null
01575:                             _statusMessage.value = "Copiado exitosamente: $targetName"
01576:                             activeCopyMoveSessions.remove(destPath)
01577:                             delay(1200)
01578:                             _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != destPath }
01579:                             if (isConnected()) {
01580:                                 listDirectory(_currentPath.value)
01581:                             }
01582:                         }
01583:                     } catch (e: Exception) {
01584:                         Log.e("MeshFilesCopy", "Error finishing WS copy: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
01585:                     } finally {
01586:                         tempFile.delete()
01587:                     }
01588:                 }
01589:             } else {
01590:                 tempFile?.delete()
01591:                 activeCopyMoveSessions.remove(destPath)
01592:                 _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != destPath }
01593:             }
01594:         } catch (e: Exception) {
01595:             Log.e("MeshFilesCopy", "Error finishing copy: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
01596:         }
01597:     }

01599:     private fun finishReadingFile() {
01600:         try {
01601:             val path = readingFilePath ?: return
01602:             val bytes = readingBuffer?.toByteArray() ?: ByteArray(0)
01603:             val textContent = String(bytes, Charsets.UTF_8)
01604:
01605:             scope.launch {
01606:                 _fileReadingProgress.value = 1.0f
01607:                 delay(150)
01608:                 readingFilePath = null
01609:                 readingBuffer = null
01610:                 readingTotalSize = 0L
01611:                 readingReceivedBytes = 0L
01612:                 _fileReadingProgress.value = null
01613:
01614:                 _fileContent.value = Pair(path, textContent)
01615:             }
01616:         } catch (e: Exception) {
01617:             Log.e("MeshFilesRead", "Error finishing read: ${e.localizedMessage}", e)
01618:             _fileReadingProgress.value = null
01619:         }
01620:     }

01622:     fun listDirectory(path: String) {
01623:         val targetPath = if (path.isEmpty()) "/" else path
01624:         val req = JsonObject().apply {
01625:             addProperty("action", "ls")
01626:             addProperty("path", targetPath)
01627:         }
01628:         scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
01629:             ensureConnected()
01630:             webSocket?.send(req.toString())
01631:         }
01632:     }

01635:         val path = _currentPath.value.trimEnd('/')
01636:         val fullPath = if (path.isEmpty()) "/$folderName" else "$path/$folderName"
01637:         val req = JsonObject().apply {

01641:         scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
01642:             ensureConnected()
